 HP Patwari Admit Card 2026 at hprca.hp.gov.in: Download Hall Ticket PDF Direct Link soon
 By Manish Kumar Last Updated: Nov 15, 2026, 14:02 IST HPRCA Patwari Admit Card 2026 is expected to be released soon by the Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Aayog (HPRCA) for the posts of Patwari against Post Code 25027. The Tablet-Based Test (TBT) for Patwari posts will be conducted from November 23  to November 30, 2026 across the state. Check all details here. 
 HP Patwari Admit Card 2026 at hprca.hp.gov.in: Download Hall Ticket PDF Direct Link soon 
 HPRCA Patwari Admit Card 2026: The Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Aayog (HPRCA), Hamirpur is all set to release the HPRCA Patwari Admit Card 2026 soon on its official website. The authority will be conducting the Tablet-Based Test (TBT) for Patwari against Post Code 25027 from November 23  to November 30, 2026 across the state. All those candidates who applied successfully for Patwari posts can download their hall ticket after using their login credentials at the official website of HPRCA-hprca.hp.gov.in.
 HPRCA Patwari Admit Card 2026 Date 
 Candidates appearing in the Tablet-Based Test (TBT) for Patwari posts should note that the authority will not send the hall ticket by post. However, the authority has not released any specific date for the release of the HP Patwari Admit Card 2026, as the exam is scheduled to be held from November 23; it is expected that the hall ticket will be released soon on the official website. Candidates must download their Admit Card directly from the official HPRCA website-hprca.hp.gov.in. 
 However, the exam authority will send SMS or email alerts to the candidates regarding the admit card release to the mobile number and email ID registered during application. 
 HP Patwari Admit Card 2026 Key Highlights 
 Earlier, the Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Aayog (HPRCA) had launched the recruitment drive to fill 530 Patwari (Job-Trainee) posts under the Director, Land Record, HP against Advertisement No. 08/2025. Check key highlights of the recruitment drive given below-
 Name of Organization Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Aayog 
 Post Name Patwari 
 Advt No.  08/2025 
 Total Vacancies 530 
 Exam date November 23 to November 30, 2026 
 Admit card status Soon 
 Level of Exam State-level 
 Exam Stages Written Exam, Document Verification 
 Official Website hprca.hp.gov.in 
 Download HPRCA Patwari Admit Card 2026 By Using Login Credentials 
 Candidates appearing in the written exam for the Patwari posts can download HP Patwari Admit Card 2026 from the official website after providing the login credentials to the link on the home page. You can check all the essential credentials from the information given by you during submission of the online application. 
 What Is The Exam Pattern For HPRCA Patwari 2026? 
 The Tablet-Based Test (TBT) for Patwari against Post Code 25027  will be conducted from November 23  to November 30, 2026 across the state. The exam pattern for the HP Patwari post is as follows: 
 The mode of the examination will be a Computer-Based Test (CBT). 
 The exam will consist of 120 questions. 
 Each question will carry 1 mark. 
 The duration of the exam is 90 minutes.
